Coverage_Description: Employees’ compensation (HK$100,000,000/event), helper medical cover (clinical HK$4,000/year, hospital & surgical HK$30,000/year, dental HK$2,000/year), household property/personal; optional Critical Illness Medical Top-Up covers 40 illnesses and can lift hospital-surgical annual limit to HK$200,000
pricing: Per helper: Basic Plan HK$120 (1 month), HK$280 (3 months), HK$300 (1 year), HK$550 (2 years); Comprehensive Plan HK$730 (1 year), HK$1,320 (2 years)
customer requirement: Applicant must be the employer of the insured helper; helper must perform household work
price structure: Per-person premium by selected plan and policy term; 25% premium loading for overseas helper driving duty
additional informations: 15-day waiting period for Hospital Cash Subsidy, Clinical, Hospitalisation/Surgical, Dental and Critical Illness Top-Up benefits; 12-month waiting period for maternity benefit; Basic Plan 1-month/3-month cancellation has no premium refund
